digest: - TD Cowen and AFS project record parcel shipping costs driven by higher ground rates and escalated surcharges [1]. This indicates strong parcel volumes that will increase fleet utilization and exposure for Nirvana's insured last-mile fleets [1].

new.title: Surcharges Stack Up in the Most Expensive Parcel Shipping Year on Record
new.summary: TD Cowen and AFS project record parcel shipping costs with higher ground rates and escalated surcharges.
new.evidence_quote: Surcharges Stack Up in the Most Expensive Parcel Shipping Year on Record
new.implication: Higher shipping rates indicate strong parcel volumes, which can lead to increased fleet utilization and higher exposure for last-mile fleets insured by Nirvana.
